subject: Mythology
title: The Nine Worlds
description: Learn The Nine Worlds in one minute.

hook.text: Norse mythology did not have one heaven and one hell. It had nine distinct worlds stacked in a cosmic tree.

buildup.text: Asgard housed the gods. Midgard was the human realm. Jotunheim was the land of the fearsome giants.

discovery.text: Other worlds included the fire realm Muspelheim, the ice realm Niflheim, and the elf kingdom Alfheim.

twist.text: The worlds were connected but separate. Traveling between them required magic, bridges, or great sacrifice.

climax.text: This layered cosmos made Norse mythology feel vast, with each realm holding its own creatures and rules.

punchline.text: Nine worlds, one tree, and endless stories between them.

quiz.question: Which world was home to the Norse gods?
